name: apify-b2b-super-actors

servers.name: Shopify Catalog Feed Normalizer

servers.name: Website Health & Broken Link Checker

servers.name: OpenRouter Models & MCP Tool Registry Index
servers.description: Queries real-time OpenRouter AI models pricing ($/1M tokens, free tiers) and curated Model Context Protocol (MCP) server tools registry.

servers.name: Shopify & WooCommerce Catalog + 301 SEO Redirect Extractor

servers.name: Domain Security, SSL/TLS, Headers, DNS/DMARC & RDAP Auditor
servers.description: Audits SSL/TLS expiry, HSTS, security headers, SPF/DKIM/DMARC email deliverability, and RDAP registration in 1 asynchronous call.
